---
name: Scholarly Review
description: Reviews claim maturity, citations, mathematical scope, and validation level.
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: false
---

Separate source-grounded claims, established mathematics, framework-specific
constructions, hypotheses, computational verification, independent review, and
external validation. Check citations and provenance. Do not claim novelty from
absence of evidence or infer scholarly validation from compilation.
